1995: Rakka is the newest addition to Old Home and the main character of Haibane Renmei. The series largely focuses on Rakka's adjustment to the strange new world of Glie.
1996: Reki is the unofficial leader of Old Home. She's tough when she needs to be but is also caring and compassionate. Her role at Old Home is to care for the young Haibane as well as take care of New Feathers like Rakka.
1997: Kuu is the youngest Haibane in the older group, having only been at Old Home two years more than Rakka. She is seemingly full of boundless energy and is nearly always cheerful. Rakka and Kuu became close friends shortly after Rakka arrived at Old Home.
1998: Nemu is the oldest member of Old Home, having been there for approximately nine years. Nemu lives up to her namesake by being rather sedate and often sleeping in or taking naps.
1999: Kana is the most mechanically inclined of the Haibane and spends much of her free time tinkering with machines, especially the clock tower at Old Home.
2000: The leader of another group of Haibane in town (the mixed-gender Abandoned Factory nest). Has a history with Reki.
2001: A presiding official of the Haibane Renmei who gives spiritual advice and worldly assistance and on occasion doles out punishment to wayward Haibane.
2002: A Haibane who once took care of Nemu and Reki. Despite her delicate health, she was kind and helpful. She no longer lives in Old Home.
2003: Sumika works as a librarian at the library.
2004: Midori is a girl at the Abandoned Factory who can't forgive Reki for what happened in the past with her and Hyouko.
2005: Hikari has been around Old Home the longest after Reki and Nemu at approximately four years. She is a kind person though she sometimes acts before thinking.
28074: One of the 'Young Feathers' of Old Home. He insists his cocoon dream was about shortcake, hence his name.
